script_text: Mercury-ruled Air sign Geminis, a radical shift in your communication sector is about to rewrite your entire narrative. Early in the week, Monday sees Mercury forming a tense square to Saturn in your 9th House, making professional negotiations difficult and requiring strict fact-checking. By Wednesday, the Moon in your 2nd House sextiles Jupiter, creating the perfect window to discuss a salary increase or secure a lucrative freelance contract. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when Venus enters Aries and your 11th House of networking, instantly electrifying your social calendar and bringing romantic sparks through group gatherings. Over the weekend, the Sun trines Pluto in your 8th House, revealing a hidden financial opportunity or a deep intimate transformation with a partner. Tuesday is your worst day due to that harsh Saturn friction stalling travel plans. Friday is your power day because Venus blesses your friendship sector with effortless charm. Schedule that important pitch for Thursday afternoon when your intellect is sharpest. Follow for daily updates.
